Thank you for your feedback! We appreciate your suggestion about the shelves being collapsible. 

The tank needs to hang on the tank scale to get the weight of the tank to provide a read-out. Some of our models may also have an LED tank scale that is near the control panel, so our consumers won't have to look under the grill. The location of the tank scale varies by model. 

We love to hear you are enjoying the grease tray. It's designed with a non-stick surface to funnel grease into the drip pan below for that easy clean-up. We recommend regularly scraping any buildup on the grease tray into the drip pan as part of your routine grill maintenance. This will help new drippings to flow directly into the drip pan.

We would like to hear more about the hooks and this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

Thank you for your feedback! We are sorry to hear your disappointment but yet understand your concerns about the coating chipping on the grill. No worries, we are here to help!

The lids of the Spirit E-310 are coated in porcelain enamel. Porcelain enamel is essentially baked on glass, which is very different than paint. If the porcelain enamel has become damaged, replacing the affected part is the only solution. Touch-up paint should NOT be used on damaged or chipped porcelain enamel.

We would like to review the coating on the lid and the knobs. Here at Weber, we stand by the quality of our products and cover them under great warranties. Our goal is to have you love our products just as much as we do.

Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
